page.overview:
What is Auto-steady gyrogimbal?

Auto-steady gyrogimbals were weapon components that assisted in keeping a blaster steady while firing. Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.'s LD-1 target blaster rifle employed auto-steady gyrogimbals.

Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook
